description: The workspace server: the projects people and agents author in git workspaces (an app today) and a record of what was done, over a management API a console pairs with. Needs the .NET 10 runtime (ASP.NET Core) and git.
notes: The state, projects and workspaces live in the server's data directory, away from the program files. The state database is a SQLite file in that directory; to put it in a database shared by a group or the install run: dbdataworkspace state init. Start it with: dbdataworkspace server run. Pair a console with it: dbdataworkspace server pair --max-role admin. This package carries neither bun nor a package store: a Workspace with no `apps.packageStore` set in server.yaml (and bun installed) does not build apps; it still creates projects and workspaces, edits, commits and merges. See the apps: section of the Workspace README.
